node.statement: Unitary graph and covering step: under nodes 1.1-1.3, X_V(P)=V bold-dot (J+P+g_V(P)) satisfies X_V(P)^dagger bold-dot X_V(P)=J and has a right inverse, hence belongs to calU. The C^1 injective maps P↦X_V(P) describe exactly the zero locus of X^dagger bold-dot X-J in every coordinate box where both Hermitian components have norm <2delta, and the family covers calU because for every U in calU the chart centered at V=U has q=0 and uniqueness gives g_U(0)=0.
